# RMD-B14: Enum Migration Complete

**Status**: ✅ COMPLETED

**Result**: All tables empty, all enum values valid — ready to proceed with schema migration.

## Changes Applied

### 1. Schema: Added Enums (prisma/schema.prisma)

```prisma
enum OrderStatus {
  PENDING
  PAID
  VOID
  REFUNDED
}

enum TransactionType {
  PAYMENT
  REFUND
  VOID
}

enum InvoiceStatus {
  PENDING
  PARTIAL
  PAID
  VOID
}
```

### 2. Schema: Column Type Conversions

| Model | Column | Old Type | New Type |
|-------|--------|----------|----------|
| Order | status | String (default "PENDING") | OrderStatus (default PENDING) |
| Transaction | type | String (default "PAYMENT") | TransactionType (default PAYMENT) |
| Invoice | status | String (default "PENDING") | InvoiceStatus (default PENDING) |

### 3. Repository Literals: No Changes Required

`src/lib/repositories/orderRepo.js` already uses correct string literals:
- Order status: `'PENDING'`, `'PAID'`, `'VOID'`, `'REFUNDED'` ✓
- Transaction type: `'PAYMENT'`, `'REFUND'`, `'VOID'` ✓

Prisma validates string literals against enum definitions automatically.
